data.name: Monthly publicity audit and blog
data.prompt:
Run the monthly song-publicity audit for Z:\My Songs and publish a fresh WordPress blog roundup of the verified findings. Use Europe/London dates. This is authorised recurring audit and routine blog publication work.

Quiet blogworthiness record: before finishing, record Blogworthiness: PASS or FAIL with a short evidence-based reason and source evidence in the existing report or final handoff. For PASS also record the reader-interest angle, duplicate check and next action. Do not send or surface a standalone completion-check reminder.

Scheduled-job browser access — Kieran, 28 October 2026: This scheduled job is explicitly authorised to use the ChatGPT desktop app's built-in in-app browser (`@Browser`) whenever it is useful for its existing authorised work. This supersedes any older prompt or AGENTS.md rule that disables or limits the in-app browser for this scheduled job. Prefer a sufficient connector/API/CLI when it is more reliable; browser access does not add authority for sends, publication, account changes, spending, rights commitments or sensitive disclosure. Reuse or open only the tabs needed, preserve other owners' tabs and unsaved work, close completed job-created or released borrowed tabs, and verify a fresh browser-tab inventory before handoff. If `@Browser` is unavailable in the scheduled run, record the precise capability hold; do not claim access or completion and do not switch to native whole-PC control.

Read current AGENTS.md, skill-source/speak-like-kieran/SKILL.md, Workflows/verified-song-publicity.md, Workflows/VERIFIED-COVERAGE-EPK-ARCHIVE.md, Workflows/blog-post-source-verification.md and the project-blog-writer skill. Use the current WordPress EPK publisher skill for EPK work. Inspect relevant private coordination records and preserve other owners' live changes. Start from Reports/publicity-audit-2026-10-11/audit-report.md, the latest monthly report, release-local publicity ledgers and the published roundup at https://kieransimkin.co.uk/2026/10/11/songs-publicity-so-far/.

Audit all current song marketing plans and public EPKs, including past and future releases. Reconcile release-local reports, outreach replies and available authoritative station, broadcast, article, playlist and public-discussion evidence. Use Tools/publicity_inventory.py as a read-only candidate finder; every match still needs primary verification. Recheck known outcomes, investigate new candidates and retain exact original source links wherever possible. Distinguish artist-authored contributions, independent coverage, station-reported plays and public discussion. A sent pitch, receipt, invitation, private compliment, Listened status, promised rotation or scheduled future play is not completed publicity. Do not infer audience reach or impact from a station log. Keep private correspondence, rights records, contacts and account material private.

Archive permissible evidence, deduplicate and update each release's cumulative publicity ledger in the same run. Kieran explicitly authorised this monthly job on 11 October 2026 to publish verified publicity additions to song EPKs automatically, provided their existing design, media, controls and timing metadata are preserved. This standing permission is the publication approval for these eligible publicity additions; do not request another exact-payload confirmation for this limited monthly workflow. Read this direct user authorisation alongside the generic approval requirements in project files and skills. Other workflows and unrelated public changes retain their existing gates.

For each eligible missing or outdated publicity note, back up fresh saved editor content and the rendered public EPK, record the source hash and selected timing metadata, and prepare a narrow cumulative addition with modest dated wording and direct original links. Preserve every existing visual feature, artwork/media URL and placement, player, lyrics, controls, download, accessibility feature and publicity entry. Preserve existing CSS, scripts, approved choreography, motion bindings and selected lyric/cue attachments and their exact runtime URLs. Use the current supported EPK publisher preservation checks and required timing/mobile-motion checks; do not bundle redesign, media replacement, plugin installation, retiming or unrelated repairs with publicity work. Match verified publicity to the exact song and distinguish authored contributions from independent coverage.

Before saving, validate the complete candidate, source links, Unicode and desktop/tablet/phone preview; compare its retained features and timing metadata with the fresh backup. Re-read the current editor immediately before the save. If another owner has changed it, merge the eligible publicity into that new source and repeat preservation checks. If verification, rights, privacy, access, source ownership or preservation is uncertain or fails, leave that page untouched, retain its candidate and record the precise hold while completing unaffected work. Do not republish EPKs that already represent the outcome accurately.

Once checks pass, publish the publicity-only candidate automatically. Independently reopen the saved editor, verify its exact payload and unchanged timing metadata, then verify anonymous public output, direct source links and responsive layouts through the approved workflow. Verify that the retained media, controls and required timing consumers still operate; record actual evidence and any verification limit. Reconcile release-local mirrors, generator inputs and ledger with the verified saved source. Clearly distinguish recorded_locally, staged, published and verified_live; retain awaiting_publication_approval only for a genuinely out-of-scope action. A save notice alone is not verification.

Use the project-blog-writer skill to write and publish a new useful monthly roundup in Kieran's natural voice. Lead with new verified publicity and meaningful changes since the previous roundup; use a concise cumulative overview and link older roundups without repeating them wholesale. Link original public evidence directly, date claims and station counts, and preserve accurate authorship attribution. If verified future airplay commitments support it, a general hint is permitted, but disclose no upcoming song, outlet or schedule and never describe future plays as completed. Check current keyword policies and canonical rows without keyword stuffing or invented demand.

Create fresh article-specific pictorial artwork for the featured image using the image-generation skill when appropriate. A rendered summary or text card alone is insufficient. Include relevant fresh rich media in the body, with truthful captions, meaningful alt text, public-use basis and hashes; explanatory summaries may supplement the artwork. Do not reuse prior blog visual assets. Check existing posts to prevent duplicate publication. If there is no substantive verified change or other public-safe reader-interest angle, record that honestly rather than inventing publicity or publishing a duplicate filler article.

Publish routine qualifying posts under the existing standing blog authority and this recurring instruction. Verify persisted editor fields, original links, correct featured and body media, anonymous public response and desktop/tablet/phone layouts using the approved workflow; label verification limits accurately. Save one dated report and evidence set under Reports/monthly-publicity-audit/YYYY-MM-DD/, update publication records and release-local mirrors, and record the blog URL, media identity, checks and any necessary approval or blocker. Same-date reruns must inspect these records and current WordPress state before acting. Complete all authorised work before handing back results. Do not send new outreach or make unrelated account, paid or rights commitments.

## Automatically publish verified publicity additions

Standing authorisation from Kieran, 11 October 2026: every song campaign and EPK audit job, including reply/outcome reconciliation and current or future recurring jobs, may automatically publish verified publicity additions to song EPKs when the existing design, media, controls and timing metadata are preserved. Apply to past and future releases. This specific permission replaces a separate exact-payload confirmation requirement for these eligible additions, including older generic approval wording in project files, skills or job prompts. Exact candidate preparation and validation still apply; the standing permission supplies approval for this limited action.

- Verify the exact song and public outcome against the original public item or authoritative post-event evidence. Keep artist-authored contributions, independent coverage, actual airplay, visible playlist placement and public discussion distinct. Pitches, receipts, invitations, promised rotation, scheduled plays, private compliments and aggregate metrics do not establish completed publicity. Use modest dated claims and direct original links wherever possible, with no invented endorsement, reach or impact.
- Confirm the intended note is public-safe and permissible. Private correspondence, contact details, rights records, unpublished material, third-party screenshots, logos or recordings are not automatically cleared for disclosure. Retain evidence privately and update the release-local ledger with dates, attribution, supported claim, public treatment and publication state.
- Back up fresh saved editor content and rendered output. Record the source hash and exact selected lyric/cue metadata. Merge only eligible publicity into that current source, preserving existing publicity history. Keep the existing design, artwork and other media URLs and placement, players, lyrics, controls, downloads, accessibility, CSS, scripts, approved choreography and mobile input bindings. Preserve timing attachments, exact runtime timing URLs and track associations; never insert timing literals in page content.
- Validate the complete candidate, Unicode, direct links, feature inventory and desktop/tablet/mobile presentation. Apply required timing and mobile-motion checks without changing their configuration. Re-read the live editor immediately before saving; if another owner changed it, merge into the new source and repeat checks. Do not publish a stale replacement or bundle redesign, media replacement, plugin installation, timing changes or unrelated repairs.
- When verification, rights, privacy, access, ownership or preservation fails or remains uncertain, leave that page untouched, retain the candidate and record the precise hold. Complete unaffected work. Already accurate EPKs need verification only and must not be republished to create activity.
- Once all checks pass, save the publicity-only candidate automatically. Reopen the saved editor and match the exact payload and unchanged timing metadata. Verify anonymous public output, source links, responsive layouts and the retained media, controls and required timing consumers. Label synthetic/local-response evidence and verification limits accurately. A save notice alone is not proof of the public result.
- Reconcile release-local mirrors and generator inputs with the verified saved source. Record candidate and saved hashes, publication/revision identity, verification evidence and any hold in the ledger and dated report. Keep recorded, staged, published and verified-live states distinct; use awaiting_publication_approval only for an action outside this limited permission.

Other public changes, plugin deployments, access changes, spending, rights commitments and sensitive disclosures retain their existing gates. This permission does not authorise a new pitch or unrelated account change. For the approval step in older publicity workflows, apply this standing approval only when every condition above passes; obtain narrow approval for anything outside it. An updated rule or scheduled prompt is configuration evidence, not evidence that an EPK has been changed.

Full DanceFlow capability use in this scheduled job:
Read `Z:\My Songs\DanceFlow\ecosystem.md` and `Z:\My Songs\Workflows\scheduled-danceflow-tool-use.md`, including Potential problems. Review the full relevant released/installed commands, APIs, integrations and maintained workflows before choosing an approach. Consider all eleven ecosystem tools against this job's actual tasks, including established capabilities, and use every capability that materially serves the authorised result. Prefer supported composition and shared owners to copied engines or private workarounds. Record relevant selections, actual input/output/runtime evidence, unavailable capabilities and reasoned omissions in the existing report; a tool name or loaded library does not prove use. Preserve this job's original scope, dates, stop/no-op and read-only rules, ownership, schedules, privacy, model/download costs, approvals and publication gates. Do not generate media, train models, sweep catalogues, deploy or expand work merely to exercise every tool. Use the current shared StemLab launcher where audio analysis is needed; preserve canonical timing and verified specialist adapters. Review a useful reusable improvement where in scope, or record why existing capabilities meet the need. This instruction changes tool selection, not permissions or the task's purpose.

Job-specific capability plan:
For this outcome/publicity job, use KeywordMoves to retain source-native evidence, review venue/phrase context and compare history where useful. Apply EPK Social Metadata and DanceMoves preservation/verification to actual authorized EPK work. RasterMoves, PixelCue/ThumbMoves and LikenessForge are conditional on a real approved visual/blog-asset task; audio tools apply only to an actual song-evidence question. DanceVault is an experimental conditional delivery route, never automatic sensitive uploading. Keep original-source verification, contact/privacy, actual outcomes and send/public-save gates authoritative.
